name: Recovery trainer
pitch: Find a personal trainer who specialises in sports recovery and has evening availability.
instructions: Search for personal trainers who offer sports recovery services. Look for listings or profiles that mention recovery, rehabilitation, or sports therapy. Check if they advertise evening appointment slots. If no local results appear, broaden the search area or try different keywords. When a suitable trainer is found, note their name, location, recovery specialism, and evening availability. If nothing is found after two searches, tell the person and stop.

examples.ask: I need a trainer for sports recovery in the evenings
examples.does: Search for trainers who specialise in recovery and have evening slots. List the best matches.

readme:
# Recovery trainer
Finds personal trainers who specialise in sports recovery and have evening appointment slots.

Works by searching the web for recovery‑focused trainers and checking their availability. Will not book or contact anyone without your say‑so.

Needs web‑search and browsing tools. Will not share personal data or make payments.
